articles.title: Capcom Announces Plans to Transform the RE Engine Into an AI-Generation Game Engine — ‘Our Goal Is a Future Where We Create Games Together With AI’
articles.summary: Resident Evil and Street Fighter developer Capcom revealed some big changes coming to its RE Engine, which they plan to incrementally improve and transform into an "AI-generation game engine." On October 2, Capcom held its own tech conference, called ‘Capcom Open Conference RE: 2026.’ One of the…
body: As reported by Japanese news outlet GameBiz, Ishida mentioned three major issues that Capcom is currently experiencing when it comes to game development: First, games are now so massive that simple processes have become extremely time-consuming; increased numbers of staff mean an engine is needed that’s easy for everyone to use; and finally, “successfully integrating AI technology into development workflows has become an essential condition for streamlining future development.”

GameBiz’s report confirmed that REX was created to help solve these problems by improving the efficiency of game development, game performance, tools, quality assurance, etc. Capcom felt that, rather than creating a brand-new engine from scratch, gradually adding these improvements over time is the best way to help evolve the RE Engine to the next generation.

We won’t get into the weeds of all the specific improvements included in the REX program, but Capcom is making at least some of them open-source for the purpose of training AI. Most interestingly, AI plays into Capcom’s larger, long-term goal of turning the RE Engine into an “AI-generation game engine” using its REX improvements.
points: Resident Evil and Street Fighter developer Capcom revealed some big changes coming to its RE Engine, which they plan to incrementally improve and transform into an "AI-generation game engine.

articles.title: End Of Abyss Patch Fixes Most Of My Complaints Just One Day After Launch
articles.summary: I spent a few days playing Section 9 Interactive's creepy metroidvania and writing my End of Abyss review, and ultimately concluded it was a fun but inconsistent experience hindered by a few particular issues.
body: If you missed the review, my main concern was how the in-game map would sometimes share incorrect information, like telling me a door was locked when I had unlocked it, or failing to signify when I'd found the key to a particular door. In a metroidvania, this means a whole lot. End of Abyss is a game about exploration, including lots of backtracking via roundabout paths, so when I'd plan long treks across the world based on a faulty map, it was really frustrating to find out too late that I'd essentially been lied to.

But a patch has fixed that, among other problems, and it presents an uncommon issue for me. My review only went out two days ago. The game only launched yesterday. Now much of my review is already outdated. In this era of live-service games and post-launch updates, it's common for games to change shape over time, but for End of Abyss's patch to fix many of its lesser parts essentially right after the deadline isn't normally how it goes.

articles.title: Former NFL Coach Mike Tomlin Is a Hardcore Minecraft Player, Reveals City He Took 12 Years to Build
articles.summary: Former NFL coach Mike Tomlin spent 19 seasons with the Pittsburgh Steelers and won Super Bowl LXIII, and now he's added another major accomplishment to his resume: becoming a Minecraft YouTuber.
body: The former coach gave football fans a little something different when he launched his new YouTube channel earlier this week. With a profile picture taken in front of NBC's Football Night in America logo, watchers probably weren't expecting Tomlin's first upload to see him confess how his love for architecture and family led him to work on a Minecraft city he spent 12 years building.

"You know, 12 or 13 years ago, when my kids were in middle school, they'd be in their room all weekend and have friends over. They were obsessed with playing this game, Minecraft, that I knew nothing about," he explained as his son and channel operator, Dino, sat in the background. "I got interested because I just was mesmerized by what could occupy their attention for such large periods of time."

He admitted he lacked the "stick control" to handle something like Minecraft's Survival mode but still managed to find enjoyment in Creative Mode. That's where Mojang's systems really started to click.

articles.title: Disney Says Conversations About Buying Epic Games Are Not Happening 'Right Now'
articles.summary: Disney has responded after rumors suggested it was interested in buying Fortnite developer Epic Games. Disney president and chief creative officer Dana Walden touched on the company's relationship with Epic during an interview with Bloomberg Live.
body: "Well, I think that it was pretty obvious that we had very serious conversations about an investment and an equity stake," Walden responded. "Those are not the conversations we're having right now, but we have a great partnership and a number of launches coming up over the next two years that are going to demonstrate the value of this partnership."

The relationship referenced here was solidified when Disney announced it acquired a $1.5 billion stake in Epic back in early 2024. It was a massive play that it promised would result in collaborations across Fortnite and more in the future.

"Our exciting new relationship with Epic Games will bring together Disney’s beloved brands and franchises with the hugely popular Fortnite in a transformational new games and entertainment universe," then-CEO Bob Iger said. "This marks Disney’s biggest entry ever into the world of games and offers significant opportunities for growth and expansion. We can’t wait for fans to experience the Disney stories and worlds they love in groundbreaking new ways."
points: Disney has responded after rumors suggested it was interested in buying Fortnite developer Epic Games.

articles.title: GTA 6 Screenshot Suggests It Won’t Be Shy About Movie References
articles.summary: A new screenshot from Grand Theft Auto 6 has arrived, and fans immediately noticed that it appears to be referencing the iconic opening scene from Quentin Tarantino's 1994 crime movie Pulp Fiction. The image was shared by Love magazine on Instagram.
body: In Pulp Fiction, Tim Roth and Amanda Plummer's characters, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny, go on to rob the diner, and given that Lucia and Jason are criminals as well, it's not a stretch to think that could happen in GTA 6. Maybe they're just enjoying breakfast, but that seems unlikely given the image clearly shows both gripping their pistols, with Lucia seemingly ready to fill the empty duffel bag next to her with cash and other valuables.

GTA 6 tells a Bonnie and Clyde-style story of two lovers who are also criminals. Things did not end well for them, and many are speculating as to how GTA 6's story could wrap up for both Lucia and Jason. It also wouldn't be surprising to see GTA 6 reference Pulp Fiction given how GTA games in the past have featured very overt references to movies, like how Vice City had Scarface references and GTA 5 had nods to Heat.

"We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other,”GTA 6 writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern told Love magazine. “That’s what we felt made them authentic, and a great team.”

articles.title: Lanterns: Who Killed Hal Jordan and More of Our Biggest Questions Heading Into the Finale
articles.summary: Who killed Hal Jordan? Is Hal Jordan even dead!? What's up with Sinestro and that planet? We have so many questions heading into the Lanterns season finale...
body: Lanterns, am I right? While the HBO series set in James Gunn’s DC Universe was divisive among some fans at the outset – what with the whole killing off Hal Jordan in the first episode situation – it has become increasingly buzzy with each passing week, with showrunner Chris Mundy and his fellow creators Damon Lindelof and Tom King building mystery upon mystery over the course of the first season.

And now, as we head into the season finale this weekend, there are a ton of questions that need to be answered. We’re breaking down the biggest ones we have right here, but please comment below and let us know what other questions you might have regarding Lanterns Season 1… and the possible answers and theories you have as well!

Which brings us to Kerry’s son, Noah (Shea Pritchard). There sure seems to be something fishy with this kid – the dude went and copped out on the college hat ceremony after the whole town showed up for it with bated breath! He also, you know, had a grandmother (step-grandmother, but still) who was a Manhunter. We’ll talk more about him below, but he’s high on the list of suspects.

articles.title: Quentin Tarantino's First Movie Sequel Officially Arrives Next Month
articles.summary: Seven years after the fact, Quentin Tarantino's period action-drama Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood is getting an official sequel, just not one directed by Tarantino himself.
body: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth — previously known simply as The Adventures of Cliff Booth — will make its Netflix debut on Dec. 23, but audiences will have a chance to see it in theaters much sooner.

Fincher and Tarantino fans will get an early look at the film in November. Netflix has an exclusive two-week run in IMAX theaters starting Nov. 25. So if you want to see what a Fincher-led sequel to Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood looks like on the biggest screen, you have a limited window.

Pitt will reprise his Best Supporting Actor Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth in the film. While the original film was set in 1969, the sequel will take place in 1977 in "a very different Hollywood," Netflix says. The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Peter Weller, Matt Groove, JB Tadena, Corey Fogelmanis, and Karren Karagulian. Fincher directed from a script written by Tarantino, the latter of which has not revealed his 10th and final film-directing project.
points: Seven years after the fact, Quentin Tarantino's period action-drama Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood is getting an official sequel, just not one directed by Tarantino himself.

articles.title: Fire Emblem Fans Just Cracked Fortune’s Weave’s Biggest Mystery (Maybe)
articles.summary: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave 's protagonist, Eshmel (or whatever you call them), is a lot like Three Houses ' Byleth. They say little, someone else's soul inhabits their body, and despite ostensibly having no personality, they're the most important person (well, construct) in the empire.
body: This piece contains spoilers for Parts 2 and 3 of Fortune's Weave.

When Fortune's Weave starts, you're literally creating Eshmel. Fortuna and the leader of Kunlun village use ancient space technology to create a Mediator, a theoretically perfect being designed to shepherd the villagers. I have no idea where Mediator souls come from or if they even have souls. (We need DLC with Anatolia's route!) But for Eshmel, Fortuna plucks one out of the aether and says it's fitting for this soul to make amends and restore light to Dagda. The words mean little at the time, and over the course of altering the Flame Lords' fate, you run into a lot of people who really, really need to make amends for one thing or another.

And in the end, Fortune's Weave never directly tells you who Eshmel is, or used to be. They're just the Herald of the Pale Raven, a being of prophecy leading the ruined populace of Dagda in its fight against Balor and the underworld. However, there's a convincing theory circulating around Reddit and GameFAQs about who Eshmel was in their previous life. If you played Cai's route or completed Anna's paralogue, you might've noticed some of these similarities yourself.
points: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave 's protagonist, Eshmel (or whatever you call them), is a lot like Three Houses ' Byleth.
They say little, someone else's soul inhabits their body, and despite ostensibly having no personality, they're the most important person (well, construct) in the empire.

articles.title: GTA 6 Should “Blaze A Trail” To More Expensive Games, Dev Says
articles.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is priced at $80 for its standard edition. Another voice has come forward to say they hope other teams follow suit and charge more for new games to help the industry at a time when developers are closing up shop, cancelling games, and laying off developers on a regular basis.
body: Martin Klima, the co-founder of Kingdom Come developer Warhorse, told PC Gamer that raising unit prices would "help a lot," but "everybody's scared to death" to do it.

"Now, hopefully, GTA will blaze the trail, and it will allow us to increase the cost," he said, adding that Rockstar and Take-Two are among the only companies who can "afford, or who can dare" to raise prices in this way.
He added that price increases for new games are "long overdue and also necessary for this business to survive."

Take-Two was among the first big publishers to drive prices up from $60 to $70, kicking this off with NBA 2K21 in 2020. Numerous other publishers followed suit, and now $70 is the norm. Defending the price increase, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick said production costs increased by 300%.

articles.title: There’s Literally Never Been a Better Time to Get Into Tactics Games
articles.summary: The tactics genre is undergoing an undeniable renaissance right now, and has been for a little while. However, I'm someone who, until recently, never gave it a fair shot; I played a lot of Worms as a kid, not to mention the incredible Hogs of War, but those were as close as I got to the genre.
body: Part of the reason I mentally wrote them off for ages was because I spent most of my teenage years playing fast-paced, reflexive genres: first-person shooters, sports, and action RPGs. I didn't think I'd vibe with the slower nature of setting up units turn-by-turn, planning each move, then watching a plan play out. I was so wrong, and right now, I'm relishing the fact there are so many phenomenal tactics games available, not to mention a terrific slate of upcoming ones.

The modern era of tactics games has had so many excellent entries over the past few years: Mario + Rabbids: Kingdom Battle, Blood Bowl 3, Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden, Gears Tactics, Jagged Alliance 3, Wargroove, Mewgenics, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, the list goes on. But I'd be remiss not to highlight Star Wars Zero Company especially. If you're a Star Wars fan, playing it is a no-brainer.

However, I'm someone who, until recently, never gave it a fair shot; I played a lot of Worms as a kid, not to mention the incredible Hogs of War, but those were as close as I got to the genre.

articles.title: GTA 6 Takes The Ridiculous World We Live In And Turns It Up To 11
articles.summary: Video games are usually a few steps removed from reality, but with Grand Theft Auto 6, developer Rockstar Games aims to reflect and amplify the current state of the world with an "over the top" experience.
body: "If you are going to put all this effort into creating a version of today’s world, it has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face," senior VP of narrative Rupert Humphries said to Love Magazine. "Otherwise, you could just go outside and live in the real world."

Humphries also described the world of GTA 6 as "a pressure cooker for all kinds of insanity," as the protagonists, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, are polar opposites. Game writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern described Lucina as an ambitious go-getter who'll do anything to get the life she dreams of, while Jason is bound by life's circumstances. "We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other," Gauvey-Kern said.

articles.title: GTA 6's 18+ age rating reveals Lucia and Jason can partake in drug use "directly from their inventory" and "at any time"
articles.summary: GTA 6 is seemingly adding another naughty pastime to the series' already mammoth collection of naughty pastimes. Joining the strip clubs and violent car-jackings and carefree murder is "frequent and prominent" drug use that you can try "at any time," according to a new age rating.
body: Grand Theft Auto 6 recently received a PEGI 18+ age rating that was uploaded and then quickly deleted from the Pan European Game Information board's website, but not before fans saved and then shared details from the listing.

Most of PEGI's description covers what you'd expect from a Grand Theft Auto game. There's murder, robberies, gun crime, other illegal shenanigans and lots of swears. What's new in this sixth numbered GTA is the free usage of hard drugs, apparently.

"Drug use is frequent and prominent with the player being able to partake in drug use with others and to use illegal drugs directly from their inventory," the now-deleted rating stated. "Most notably, cocaine can be carried around by the player and snorted directly from their hand at any time."

While most GTA stories usually centre drug trade in some fashion, most of the series' protagonists aren't so enthusiastic about using the goods they sell. GTA 5 and GTA Online both include optional bongs, sure, but they can normally only be found in player-owned apartments, not carried about in the wider world.
points: GTA 6 is seemingly adding another naughty pastime to the series' already mammoth collection of naughty pastimes.

articles.title: "This is your Dreamcast moment": Former PlayStation boss thinks Xbox needs to "pick a lane" with exclusive games to fix itself
articles.summary: Former PlayStation boss Shawn Layden has some thoughts on where Team Xbox is at right now and where the green machine can go from here, but the console maker needs to "pick a lane" with exclusive games, either way.
body: As Xbox Series X/S console sales continued to decline this generation, the company flip-flopped quite a few times when it came to its first-party exclusives. Microsoft went from releasing almost all of its games exclusively on PC and Xbox consoles to becoming a sort-of third-party publisher during Phil Spencer 's tenure as head of Xbox - everything from Starfield to Halo: Campaign Evolved found their way to PS5.

In a chat with The Expansion Pass podcast (embedded below), Layden said most of Xbox's current woes come from the company's inability to commit to exclusives. "Or if they picked a lane, they didn't stay in it very long," he said. "Are you going to be a platform? A platform needs exclusives or else the platform has no meaning. Or are you going to be the biggest publisher in the world now that you have Activision and Blizzard? And if you're the biggest publisher in the world, you almost have to be on every platform because that's how the business model works. You can't be successful at both."

videos.summary: I never would have guessed that putting roguelike elements into a racer would create a winning formula.
body: I felt such a sense of whiplash jumping into Star Wars Galactic Racer from Zero Company. Unlike Zero Company--and plenty of the other Star Wars games we've gotten in recent years, like Survivor and Squadrons--Galactic Racer isn't trying to emulate the science-fantasy drama that defines the majority of the Star Wars movies and other assorted fiction.

videos.title: World of Tanks Modern Armor - Steel Asylum Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
videos.summary: Beware, Commander: the battlefield has descended into madness.
body: Step into Steel Asylum, the latest season of World of Tanks Modern Armor, and face 100 Stages packed with rewards worthy of those brave enough to confront the unknown. Earn Gold, War Chests, Premium Account time, Premium tanks, and more as you fight your way through a season where fear lurks around every corner.

Unlock the Season Pass and make your escape with the VCC-80/60, an Escalation Era Light Tank built to strike from the shadows and keep enemies guessing. Looking for an even greater advantage? The Ultimate Season Pass immediately grants you the Serpente — a deadly Tier IX medium tank ready to spread panic across the battlefield — and Desmond "Doc" Rose, a 3D Hero Commander whose unsettling expertise may be exactly what you need to survive the chaos ahead.
